_source: Five Parsecs From Home: Compendium, Bug Hunt, printed pp.172 (standard equipment), 178 (Saving throws); pages verified 2026-09-20 against the PDF page tails and the p.223 index
description: Bug Hunt armor. The book defines exactly ONE: p.172 gives the standard load as a Service Pistol and Trooper armor, and p.178 states the rule. Combat Armor and a Scout Suit were listed here until 2026-09-20 and are NOT Bug Hunt items -- Combat Armor is a Core Rules item (pp.29, 54, 132) at Saving Throw 5+, and a Scout Suit is in neither book. Do not re-add either.

armor.name: Trooper Armor
armor.description: All figures noted as wearing trooper armor receive a saving throw on 5-6.
